SkyForge converts an equirectangular panorama (2:1) into a 6-face skybox
in the classic GoldSrc/Xash3D format (`ft/bk/up/dn/rt/lf.tga`), built for
the PrimeXT/Xash3D modding community.

## Download

Download `SkyForge.exe` below and double-click it — nothing else to
install. Everything (GUI, Python runtime, the `cmft` conversion engine)
is bundled into that single file.

## What's validated in this version

- Full pipeline tested with real photos, end to end.
- Face orientation confirmed **in-game** (PrimeXT): `ft`/`bk`/`rt`/`lf`/`up`
  are seamless. `dn` hasn't been tested in-game yet (rarely visible,
  usually covered by terrain).
- `SkyForge.exe` tested running for real on Windows, not just simulated.
- Accepts PNG, JPG, TGA or BMP as input.
- Interface available in Portuguese and English (switchable anytime from
  the **Language** menu).
